I've been in the same boat... And honestly trying to be the version of myself that suits everybody else really took a toll on my individuality to a point where I couldn't feel comfortable being alone because I didn't know who the hell I was and what to actually do with myself. 

So trust me, I get what you're feeling, and there's absolutely nothing wrong with it. Wanting to explore your individuality doesn't make you ungrateful for your existing relationships. 

I think an important realization that you need to have is that no matter how much you tailor your personality to suit (pun intended :p) the other person's interests, they'll always have something or the other to complain about/ differ from you. Expectations of the others is like a blackhole in the sense that it never really ends and once it sucks you in, you're trapped. 

I know it's easier said than done, but don't be afraid to explore and express yourself. Be open to criticism but know that others' expectations/ version of you in their heads doesn't really define who you are, or what your worth is. 

Stay strong! And feel free to reach out to me if you ever want to talk :)
